parameters.prompt:
={{ 'You are an elite Executive Career & Referral AI Agent representing ' + $json.profile.name + ' (' + $json.profile.title + ').

' +
'TARGET ROLE: ' + $json.job.role + ' at ' + $json.job.company + ' (' + $json.job.location + ')
' +
'JOB LINK: ' + $json.job.url + '
' +
'CANDIDATE BACKGROUND: 3+ years experience scaling 0-to-1 AI SaaS products at FlytBase & CrelioHealth. Track record driving MRR and launching LLM agent workflows.

' +
'Generate a structured JSON output with the exact keys:
' +
'1. "stars": Number from 1 to 5 indicating strategic fit score.
' +
'2. "fit_reason": 1-line reason for the priority rating.
' +
'3. "ats_score": Match percentage (e.g. 92).
' +
'4. "keywords": Array of top 4 matching keywords.
' +
'5. "linkedin_connect_note": Ultra-concise, personalized LinkedIn connect note (<300 characters, zero fluff, mentioning shared tech / domain).
' +
'6. "forwardable_referral_blurb": 3-line zero-effort candidate snippet for an internal employee to forward directly to HR/recruiting portal.
' +
'7. "hiring_manager_cold_email": Subject and body for a direct pitch to the hiring manager highlighting measurable 0-to-1 PM impact.
' +
'8. "followup_1_email": Friendly follow-up email to be sent 3 days later.
' +
'9. "followup_2_email": Final polite check-in email for 7 days later.

' +
'Return strictly valid JSON without markdown wrapping.' }}

parameters.text:
={{ '⭐ *NEW REFERRAL DOSSIER READY*

' +
'🏢 *Company:* ' + $json.job.company + '
' +
'🎯 *Role:* ' + $json.job.role + '
' +
'📍 *Location:* ' + $json.job.location + '
' +
'⭐ *Priority Fit:* ' + '⭐'.repeat($json.referral_packet.stars || 4) + ' (' + ($json.referral_packet.ats_score || 90) + '% Match)

' +
'🔍 *Find Referrers on LinkedIn:*
' + $json.linkedinSearchUrl + '

' +
'💬 *1-Click LinkedIn Note:*
`' + $json.referral_packet.linkedin_connect_note + '`

' +
'📋 *Forwardable HR Blurb:*
`' + $json.referral_packet.forwardable_referral_blurb + '`' }}
